title: These Days
subtitle: 本課限定語境：these days = during the present period; in modern life; now compared with the past
description: 本課限定語境：these days = during the present period; in modern life; now compared with the past ·「現今；如今；現在這個時期」

words.note: 表示現在這個時代，通常暗示和以前相比已有變化。
words.example: Nowadays, many people work from home at least part of the week.
words.exampleZh: 如今很多人每週至少有部分時間在家工作。

exercises.original: These days, many people use mobile banking instead of visiting a branch.
exercises.upgrade: Nowadays, many people use mobile banking instead of visiting a branch.

options.explanation: 現代社會的一般習慣，而且暗含和過去比較。
偏不久前，不是一般現況。

exercises.original: These days, students often submit assignments online.
exercises.upgrade: Nowadays, students often submit assignments online.

options.explanation: 有一定可能，但更像某校目前安排。
描述現代教育的一般趨勢。

exercises.original: These days, it is common for meetings to include remote participants.
exercises.upgrade: Nowadays, it is common for meetings to include remote participants.

options.explanation: it is common 表示現代常態。

words.note: 表示某件事在目前這段時間成立或正在發生。
words.example: The museum is currently closed for renovation.
words.exampleZh: 博物館目前因翻新而關閉。

exercises.original: These days, the museum is closed for renovation.
exercises.upgrade: The museum is currently closed for renovation.

options.explanation: 翻新關閉是目前暫時狀態。
表示不久前發生，不等於目前仍關閉。

exercises.original: She is these days working on a research project in Singapore.
exercises.upgrade: She is currently working on a research project in Singapore.

options.explanation: 和 present continuous 很自然。
需不同句法，如 recently started。

exercises.original: The company these days has offices in six countries.
exercises.upgrade: The company currently has offices in six countries.

options.explanation: 陳述公司現時營運狀態。
不如 currently 自然描述靜態現況。

words.note: 較正式地表示現在的狀況。
words.example: At present, the service is available in three cities.
words.exampleZh: 目前這項服務在三個城市提供。

exercises.original: These days, no final decision has been made.
exercises.upgrade: At present, no final decision has been made.

options.explanation: 不適合具體決定目前未作出。

exercises.original: These days, the service is available in three cities.
exercises.upgrade: At present, the service is available in three cities.

options.explanation: 正式地描述目前覆蓋範圍。
不自然描述服務覆蓋狀態。

exercises.original: These days, we do not have enough information to confirm the cause.
exercises.upgrade: At present, we do not have enough information to confirm the cause.

words.note: 正式書面語中可表示 currently。
words.example: The company presently employs around 500 people.
words.exampleZh: 公司目前約有五百名員工。

exercises.original: The building is these days used as a training centre.
exercises.upgrade: The building is presently used as a training centre.

exercises.original: The organization these days operates from two temporary offices.
exercises.upgrade: The organization presently operates from two temporary offices.

exercises.original: The software is these days available only to registered users.
exercises.upgrade: The software is presently available only to registered users.

words.note: 除了「今天」，today 也可以表示現代社會。
words.example: Young people today have access to far more information than previous generations.
words.exampleZh: 當今年輕人能接觸到的資訊遠多於以前世代。

exercises.original: Young people these days have access to much more information than previous generations.
exercises.upgrade: Young people today have access to much more information than previous generations.

options.explanation: than previous generations 表示現代時代比較。

exercises.original: Businesses these days depend heavily on digital communication.
exercises.upgrade: Businesses today depend heavily on digital communication.

options.explanation: businesses today 是典型「當今企業」。

exercises.original: The challenges facing cities these days are very different from those of a century ago.
exercises.upgrade: The challenges facing cities today are very different from those of a century ago.

options.explanation: a century ago 提供清楚歷史對比。

words.note: 較有評論意味地表示「在現代社會裡」。
words.example: In this day and age, basic digital skills are essential in many jobs.
words.exampleZh: 在現今這個時代，基本數碼技能對很多工作都很重要。

exercises.original: These days, people expect websites to work well on mobile phones.
exercises.upgrade: In this day and age, people expect websites to work well on mobile phones.

options.explanation: 對現代社會合理期望的評論。

exercises.original: These days, basic digital skills are essential for many jobs.
exercises.upgrade: In this day and age, basic digital skills are essential for many jobs.

exercises.original: These days, it is surprising to find a business with no online presence at all.
exercises.upgrade: In this day and age, it is surprising to find a business with no online presence at all.

options.explanation: it is surprising 帶明顯評論／感嘆。

falseSynonyms.zh: 此刻 ≠ these days right now 只表示此刻，時間範圍比 these days 窄得多。
最近 ≠ 現今 recently 通常偏向不久之前發生的事。
最近這陣子 ≠ 所有 these days lately 常和完成式搭配：I've been tired lately.
暫時 ≠ 一般現況 for now 暗示之後可能改變。
此刻／目前 ≠ 現代社會 適合 current situation，不適合 broad modern trends。
今天 ≠ 一定是現今 I am busy today 只指今天；people today 可指當今人們。
兩者很接近，但 nowadays 更穩定地表示現代一般趨勢。
present 是形容詞／名詞；presently 是副詞。
